questions.q: What's the difference between shortcut mode and tutor mode?
options: Shortcut mode is slower, but you remember more
Tutor mode only works for school subjects and exams
Shortcut mode gets answers; tutor mode builds understanding
Tutor mode means the AI does all the thinking for you
questions.explain: Shortcut mode asks for the answer and little sticks. Tutor mode asks for help understanding and makes you explain, recall and correct mistakes, so you actually learn.

questions.q: You've just read an AI explanation of a new topic and want it to stick. What should you do next?
options: Read the same explanation again a few more times
Ask for a longer, more detailed explanation
Copy the explanation into your notes and move on
Ask the AI to quiz you, one question at a time
questions.explain: Testing yourself, which learning researchers call retrieval practice, is one of the most effective ways to remember things, so have the AI quiz you instead of reading passively.

questions.q: You're studying for a certification exam with an AI tutor. How should you handle the key facts it gives you?
options: Confirm them with your textbook or official guidance
Trust them fully, since AI is reliable on every topic
Ask the AI to write your practice answers for you
Skip checking, since the AI sounds confident about them
questions.explain: AI is less reliable on niche or high-stakes specifics, so for something like a certification exam the lesson says to confirm key facts with your textbook, official guidance or another trusted source.
